note: Figma variable name -> published CSS key. AUTHORED, not generated: the exporter reads this, and must never derive it from existing output. Reasoning, coverage and the killed keys are in design-system/docs/13-rename-map.md. Scope: COLOR variables of Semantic and Component. Numerics and text styles are NOT covered yet — see the doc.

semantic.rule: first matching prefix wins; the remainder is slugged ('/' -> '-') and appended

killed.reason: Every one encodes a fixed account slot (ARQ / Toptal / Bancolombia / other) from before Alfredo decided the account colour is chosen by the user. There is no Figma source for any of them; --account-2-surface has no matching value anywhere in the file. Publishing them again would re-publish a dead model under names that mean nothing.
killed.precondition: build.py MAP lines 109-112 and two src/ call sites migrate first — see docs/inbox/dev/A-2026-08-17-rename-map.md. Slot 4 is byte-identical to color/account/*, so --color-account-other-{bg,txt} -> --account-{surface,foreground} is a pixel-preserving rename.

not_covered_yet: Numeric variables (the `num` block, 108 keys). Component numerics look like the same slug rule (avatar/size/sm -> --avatar-size-sm) but this has NOT been verified key by key. Do not assume it.
Text styles (the `text` block, 26 rows). Different shape entirely: name|weight|size|lineHeight|letterSpacing.
Primitives and Typography collections are not published and need no map.
